controles.affirmation: Le fisc americain reclame environ 3,6 Mds $ pour 2010-2012, environ 5,1 Mds $ pour 2013-2015 assorti de 2,0 Mds $ de penalites, plus interets, soit environ 10,7 Mds $ affiches (ramenes a environ 7,6 Mds $ compte tenu des impots de rapatriement deja payes, jusqu'a 0,9 puis 2,2 Mds $)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, note 4 : "The Notices seek to increase our U.S. taxable income for the years 2010-2012 by an amount that would result in additional federal tax of approximately $3.6 billion, plus interest. Any additional tax that could be imposed for the years 2010-2012 would be reduced by up to approximately $900 million of repatriation tax previously accrued and paid on our foreign earnings. [...] The Notice seeks to increase our U.S. taxable income for the years 2013-2015 by an amount that would result in additional federal tax of approximately $5.1 billion, plus interest, and asserts penalties of approximately $2.0 billion. Any additional tax that could be imposed for the years 2013-2015 would be reduced by up to approximately $2.2 billion of repatriation tax previously accrued and paid on our foreign earnings."

controles.affirmation: Stade de la procedure : notices de deficience contestees devant le Tax Court, proces tenu de novembre 2024 a janvier 2025, decision attendue au plus tot fin 2026 ou debut 2027
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "in 2021, we filed a petition in the U.S. Tax Court to contest two duplicate Statutory Notices of Deficiency (Notices) for the years 2010-2012 [...] The two cases were consolidated in the U.S. Tax Court in 2022. The trial began on November 4, 2024 and concluded on January 17, 2025. [...] On March 16, 2026, the Court ordered supplemental closing briefs, which were filed on May 20, 2026. The Company expects a decision from the U.S. Tax Court no earlier than late 2026 or early 2027."

controles.affirmation: Amgen a recu en avril 2026 un projet de redressement (NOPA) pour 2016-2018 sur le meme sujet, reemis en mai puis juillet 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "We are currently under examination by the IRS for the years 2016-2018. In April 2026, we received a draft notice of proposed adjustment (NOPA) from the IRS for years 2016-2018, which is similar to the proposed adjustments for years 2010-2015 [...] In May and July 2026, the IRS reissued the NOPA in substantially the same form. We disagree with the NOPA"

controles.affirmation: Le fisc a ouvert au deuxieme trimestre 2026 le controle des exercices 2019-2022
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The IRS began its audit for years 2019-2022 in the second quarter of 2026, and we believe that it may seek to continue to audit similar issues related to the allocation of income between the United States and our foreign jurisdictions."

controles.affirmation: Le sujet est la repartition des benefices entre les entites americaines et Porto Rico, ce qui permet a Amgen d'afficher un taux d'impot effectif de 13,6% au S1 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "adjustments that primarily relate to the allocation of profits between certain of our entities in the United States and the U.S. territory of Puerto Rico" ; "The effective tax rates for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 were 14.2% and 13.6%, respectively" ; "Substantially all of the benefit to our effective tax rate from foreign earnings results from locations in which the Company has significant manufacturing operations, including Singapore, Ireland and Puerto Rico"

controles.affirmation: Amgen conteste fermement et juge les positions du fisc sans fondement, ce qui explique l'absence de provision correspondante
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "We continue to believe our accrual for income tax liabilities is appropriate based on past experience, interpretations of tax law, application of the tax law to our facts and judgments about potential actions by tax authorities; however, due to the complexity of the provision for income taxes and uncertain resolution of these matters, the ultimate outcome of any tax matters may result in payments substantially greater than amounts accrued". Bilan 30/06/2026 : "Long-term tax liabilities 2,844".
controles.correction_proposee: Amgen n'affirme nulle part une absence de provision : elle porte 2 844 M$ de dettes fiscales a long terme au 30 juin 2026 et juge son niveau de provisionnement approprie, tout en ecrivant que le denouement peut entrainer des paiements tres superieurs aux montants provisionnes. Ecrire : "Amgen juge son provisionnement approprie mais previent que les paiements finaux peuvent etre tres superieurs aux montants provisionnes ; aucune provision n'est constituee a hauteur des 10,7 Mds $ reclames."

controles.affirmation: Hook : "un contentieux fiscal dont l'enjeu affiche, environ 10,7 Mds $, depasse ses capitaux propres"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, bilan au 30/06/2026 : "Total stockholders' equity 11,688". Soit 11,7 Mds $ de capitaux propres contre 10,7 Mds $ d'exposition fiscale affichee : l'exposition NE depasse PAS les capitaux propres. L'ATT se contredit elle-meme au bloc quantitatif : "Soit 91% des capitaux propres au 30 juin 2026".
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer par : "un contentieux fiscal dont l'enjeu affiche, environ 10,7 Mds $, represente 91% de ses capitaux propres".

controles.affirmation: Exposition fiscale de 10,7 Mds $ = 91% des capitaux propres au 30 juin 2026, environ 1,4 fois le resultat net 2025 (7 711 M$)
Enbrel : prix de vente net en baisse de 22% sur le trimestre et 25% sur le semestre du fait de la fixation du prix Medicare Part D au titre de l'IRA au 1er janvier 2026, plus elargissement du 340B
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The decrease in ENBREL sales for the three months ended June 30, 2026 was primarily driven by lower net selling price of 22% resulting from the impact of U.S. Medicare Part D price setting under the IRA, effective January 1, 2026, as well as an increase in 340B Program mix" ; "...for the six months ended June 30, 2026 was driven by lower net selling price of 25%..."

controles.affirmation: Otezla selectionne par CMS en janvier 2025 pour une fixation de prix applicable en 2027, ce qui a impose une depreciation partielle de 800 M$ (juste valeur 4,0 Mds $ contre valeur comptable 4,8 Mds $)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, note 8 : "In January 2025, as part of the IRA, the Company's product Otezla was selected by CMS for Medicare price setting that will be applicable beginning on January 1, 2027. [...] In the first quarter of 2025, the Company utilized a discounted cash flow analysis based on Level 3 inputs [...] that resulted in an intangible asset fair value of $4.0 billion, which was lower than the carrying value of $4.8 billion, and a partial impairment of $800 million was recorded" ; "CMS has selected ENBREL and Otezla for Medicare price setting beginning in 2026 and 2027, respectively"

controles.affirmation: Amgen a recu la lettre MFN de l'administration americaine en juillet 2025, a annonce en decembre 2025 des mesures repondant aux demandes de prix, et participe au modele GENEROUS qui aligne les prix Medicaid sur ceux de pays etrangers
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "the July MFN Letter that was delivered to a number of pharmaceutical companies, including Amgen. In December 2025, we announced that we are taking actions that satisfy the components outlined in the July MFN Letter, including the Administration's MFN pricing requests. [...] CMS also announced the GENEROUS Model, under which we and other participating manufacturers will provide additional supplemental rebates for certain drugs to participating state Medicaid programs designed to align Medicaid net prices with prices paid in select other countries" ; glossaire : "July MFN Letter: Letter dated July 31, 2025"

controles.affirmation: Amgen a obtenu en decembre 2025 une exemption d'environ trois ans des droits de douane du secteur en contrepartie de ses investissements industriels americains
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "In April 2026, the Administration issued a proclamation imposing Section 232 tariffs on certain patented pharmaceuticals and associated active pharmaceutical ingredients. However, in December 2025, in recognition of our capital investments in U.S. manufacturing, we received relief from Section 232 tariffs for approximately the next three years from that date."

controles.affirmation: Les brevets sur les anticorps anti-RANKL protegeant Prolia et XGEVA ont expire en fevrier 2025 aux Etats-Unis et en novembre 2025 dans plusieurs pays europeens, et Amgen annonce une erosion accelerée d'ici fin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "our patents for RANKL antibodies, including sequences, for Prolia and XGEVA expired in February 2025 in the United States and in November 2025 in select countries in Europe" ; "For the remainder of 2026, we continue to expect accelerated sales erosion driven by increased competition, as multiple biosimilars have launched in the United States and ROW" (present dans les sections Prolia et XGEVA)

controles.affirmation: Otezla perd son exclusivite en Europe depuis le premier trimestre 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Otezla ROW sales were unfavorably impacted for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 by generic competition following loss of exclusivity in certain European countries during the first quarter of 2026." (le document dit "certains pays europeens", l'ATT generalise legerement a "l'Europe")

controles.affirmation: Prolia, XGEVA, Enbrel et Otezla ont genere 4 071 M$ au S1 2026 contre 5 488 M$ un an plus tot, soit -1 417 M$ et -25,8% ; ils pesent 22,9% des ventes de produits du semestre
Prolia est passee d'un pic de 1 165 M$ au T4 2024 a 759 M$ au T2 2026, soit -35% en six trimestres

Dette totale 57 304 M$ au 30/06/2026 (51 859 LT + 5 445 CT) pour 11 688 M$ de capitaux propres (4,9x), 13 989 M$ de tresorerie, goodwill 18 668 + incorporels 20 487 = 39,2 Mds soit 41% du bilan et 3,4x les capitaux propres ; dette nette 43,3 contre 45,5 Mds fin 2025 ; dette brute +2,7 Mds sur le semestre ; interets nets 1 330 M$ soit environ un cinquieme du resultat operationnel ; dividendes 2 720 M$ ; tous les engagements bancaires respectes
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, bilan : "Long-term debt 51,859 / 50,005 ; Current portion of long-term debt 5,445 / 4,599 ; Cash and cash equivalents $13,989 $9,129 ; Goodwill 18,668 ; Intangible assets, net 20,487 ; Total assets $95,639 ; Total stockholders' equity 11,688 / 8,658 ; Accumulated deficit (22,275)" ; "Total carrying value of debt 57,304 54,604" ; "Interest expense, net (1,330)" et "Operating income 6,180" ; "Dividends paid (2,720)" ; "We were in compliance with all applicable covenants under these arrangements as of June 30, 2026."

controles.affirmation: Amgen n'a rachete aucune action depuis 2023 / les rachats d'actions sont a zero depuis 2023, alors que 6,8 Mds $ d'autorisation restent inutilises
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, note 17 : "During the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2023, we did not repurchase shares under our stock repurchase program. During the year ended December 31, 2024, we repurchased 0.7 million shares of our common stock for a total cost of $200 million under our stock repurchase program. As of December 31, 2025, $6.8 billion of authorization remained available". Etat des capitaux propres : "Repurchases of common stock (0.7) - (200)" sur 2024.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : "Amgen n'a rachete aucune action en 2023, 2025 et au premier semestre 2026, et seulement 200 M$ (0,7 million d'actions) en 2024, alors que 6,8 Mds $ d'autorisation restent inutilises." Le montant de 6,8 Mds $ et l'absence de rachat au S1 2026 sont exacts.

controles.affirmation: Les 4,0 Mds $ emis en 2026 portent des coupons de 4,20% a 5,65%, contre 2,00% pour l'emprunt en euros rembourse
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "In the first quarter of 2026, we issued $4.0 billion of debt consisting of $1.0 billion of the 4.20% 2031 Notes, $1.75 billion of the 4.85% 2036 Notes, $500 million of the 5.50% 2046 Notes and $750 million of the 5.65% 2056 Notes." ; "During the six months ended June 30, 2026, we repaid the EUR 750 million aggregate principal amount of the 2.00% 2026 euro Notes ($833 million upon settlement of the related cross-currency swap)"

controles.affirmation: 23 programmes en Phase 3 au 3 fevrier 2026 contre 25 un an plus tot ; R&D 3 587 M$ au S1 2026 (+11%) attribuee a MariTide ; six etudes de Phase 3 MariTide lancees en 2025 ; aucun resultat de Phase 3 publie, donnees de Phase 2 publiees dans le NEJM, maintien du poids en 2e annee a dose mensuelle ou trimestrielle
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "As of February 4, 2025, we had 25 Phase 3 programs studied in investigational indications. As of February 3, 2026, we had 23 Phase 3 programs being studied in investigational indications, as six programs initiated Phase 3 studies, five programs received regulatory approval, one program was stopped, one program was no longer being pursued and one program concluded." ; "the initiation of six global Phase 3 clinical studies for MariTide" ; "simultaneously published in The New England Journal of Medicine" ; "the large majority of participants maintained the weight loss achieved in Part 1 for an additional 52 weeks on a lower monthly dose or quarterly dose of MariTide". 10-Q T2 2026 : "Research and development 3,587 / 3,230" (+11%) et "The increase in R&D expense for the six months ended June 30, 2026, was driven by higher spend in Later-Stage Clinical Programs, primarily those related to MariTide." Aucun resultat de Phase 3 MariTide n'apparait dans le 10-K FY2025 ni dans le 10-Q T2 2026.

controles.affirmation: 77% du chiffre d'affaires brut mondial 2025 realise avec trois grossistes pesant chacun plus de 10% des revenus totaux, et 75% des creances clients nettes ; les six principaux PBM couvrent 94% des ordonnances selon la FTC
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Our product sales to three large wholesalers, McKesson Corporation, Cencora, Inc. and Cardinal Health, Inc., each individually accounted for more than 10% of total revenues for each of the years 2025, 2024 and 2023. On a combined basis, these wholesalers accounted for 77%, 77% and 79% of worldwide gross revenues for 2025, 2024 and 2023" ; "accounted for 75% and 70%, respectively, of net trade receivables on a combined basis" ; "the six largest PBMs in the United States are now part of major health insurance providers, and the Federal Trade Commission's interim report released in 2024 showed that they nationally account for 94% of prescription drug claims"

controles.affirmation: Le prix de vente net du groupe avait recule de 3% en 2025 alors que le volume progressait de 13%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Total product sales increased 10% in 2025, driven by volume growth of 13%, partially offset by declines in net selling price of 3%."

controles.affirmation: Hook : "Derriere un resultat net en hausse de 66%"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Net income for basic and diluted EPS $2,375 $1,432 $4,194 $3,162". Le +66% correspond au SEUL deuxieme trimestre (2 375 contre 1 432 = +65,9%). Sur le semestre, base retenue par tout le reste du hook et du resume, le resultat net progresse de 4 194 contre 3 162, soit +32,6%.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : "Derriere un resultat net semestriel en hausse de 33%" ou preciser "+66% au deuxieme trimestre".

controles.affirmation: Les marques en croissance ont ajoute 1 949 M$ sur le semestre, plus que les 1 417 M$ perdus
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, ventes six mois : Repatha +477, EVENITY +316, TEPEZZA +180, BLINCYTO +133, Nplate +160, TEZSPIRE +202, KRYSTEXXA +70, Vectibix +53, UPLIZNA +330, IMDELLTRA/IMDYLLTRA +331, Other products +370. Total des produits en croissance = 2 252 M$ hors "Other products", 2 622 M$ en les incluant. Le chiffre de 1 949 M$ ne correspond qu'a un sous-ensemble de 7 produits et sous-estime la compensation.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : "les produits en croissance ont ajoute 2 252 M$ sur le semestre (2 622 M$ en incluant les autres produits), soit nettement plus que les 1 417 M$ perdus", ou preciser explicitement quels sept produits sont retenus.

controles.affirmation: Aucune de ces marques en croissance ne pese individuellement plus de 10% des ventes
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Repatha $975 $854 $1,829" et "Total product sales $12,763 $4,992 $17,755". Repatha represente 1 829/17 755 = 10,3% des ventes de produits du semestre, donc plus de 10%. Le seuil n'est respecte que si l'on rapporte Repatha aux revenus totaux (1 829/18 672 = 9,8%), base differente de celle utilisee par l'ATT deux phrases plus haut pour les 22,9%.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : "seule Repatha depasse 10% des ventes de produits (10,3%), les six autres pesent chacune moins de 8%".

controles.affirmation: Resume : "six marques en croissance a deux chiffres"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, variations six mois : Repatha +35%, EVENITY +33%, TEPEZZA +20%, BLINCYTO +18%, Nplate +23%, TEZSPIRE +32%, KRYSTEXXA +12%, UPLIZNA et IMDELLTRA/IMDYLLTRA superieurs a 100%. Soit au moins neuf produits principaux en croissance a deux chiffres, pas six. Aucun des deux documents cites ne mentionne un decompte de six marques.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : "neuf produits principaux en croissance a deux chiffres" ou supprimer le decompte.
